id: 15_Laboratory Safety Managing Compressed Gas and Cryogenic Hazards Training Course
title: 认识压缩气体的危害（国内版）
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/15_Laboratory Safety Managing Compressed Gas and Cryogenic Hazards Training Course.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/15_Laboratory Safety Managing Compressed Gas and Cryogenic Hazards Training Course（国内版）/src.py

points.K4: 易燃气体：通风、远离火源
points.K12: 危害能控制，措施要落实
points.S1: 惰性气体用气间：通风和氧含量报警
points.S2: 有毒腐蚀气体泄漏：撤离报告
points.S3: 富氧环境：衣物沾氧易燃

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排用链条固定的气瓶旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of gas cylinders chained to a wall rack and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，认识压缩气体的危害。

shots.scene: 骷髅、火焰、腐蚀、圆圈火焰、气瓶五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a skull and crossbones, a flame, a corrosion symbol, a flame over a circle, and a gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 气体有危害，气瓶本身也有危害。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在实验室气瓶旁，看着几只颜色不同的气瓶发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in a lab looking puzzled at several gas cylinders of different colors with blank labels.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次进气瓶间，看得一头雾水。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a question mark icon above him.
shots.narration: 这些气体，到底危险在哪儿？

shots.scene: 小研走过来，指着气瓶上的空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and points at the blank label on a cylinder shoulder.
shots.narration: 小研说：先看清是什么气，再说怎么防。

shots.section_title: 危害看类型：四大类，分主次
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现四个菱形危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four diamond-shaped hazard pictograms floating in the air.
shots.narration: 压缩气体的危害，要看是哪种气。
overlay: 危害看类型：四大类，分主次

shots.section_title: 危害看类型：四大类，分主次
shots.scene: 四个菱形图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four diamond hazard pictograms light up one by one: skull and crossbones, flame, corrosion, flame over circle. No people.
shots.narration: 常见四类：有毒、易燃、腐蚀、氧化。

shots.section_title: 危害看类型：四大类，分主次
shots.scene: 一只气瓶图标旁挂着一大一小两个危害图标
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder icon with one large hazard pictogram and one smaller hazard pictogram beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 一种气，常常兼有主次两种危害。

shots.scene: 丙烷气瓶图标，旁边是火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: A squat liquefied gas cylinder icon with a flame pictogram beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 比如丙烷，首先是易燃气体。

shots.scene: 房间里气体扩散，氧气小球被挤到外面
shots.prompt_en: A simple room diagram where gas spreads across the floor and small oxygen bubbles are pushed out of the room. No people.
shots.narration: 它还会挤走空气里的氧气。

shots.scene: 倒地的小人图标旁有缺氧警示
shots.prompt_en: A collapsed person pictogram with a low oxygen warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气不够，人就会窒息。

shots.section_title: 有毒气体：中毒可能延迟
shots.scene: 骷髅图标气瓶，旁边是鼻子、手、眼睛三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder with a skull and crossbones pictogram, next to icons of a nose, a hand and an eye. No people.
shots.narration: 有毒气体，吸入或沾到皮肤眼睛都危险。
overlay: 有毒气体：中毒可能延迟

shots.section_title: 有毒气体：中毒可能延迟
shots.scene: 一条量程刻度线，指针停在限值线以下
shots.prompt_en: A gauge with a marked limit line, the needle staying well below the line. No people.
shots.narration: 接触浓度不能超过职业接触限值。

shots.section_title: 有毒气体：中毒可能延迟
shots.scene: 时钟图标旁，小人图标稍后才出现不适
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon, and a person pictogram that only shows a dizzy symbol some time later. No people.
shots.narration: 中毒症状可能过一阵才出现。

shots.section_title: 有毒气体：中毒可能延迟
shots.scene: 阿杰觉得没事继续干活，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person ignoring a gas smell and continuing to work, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 当时没感觉，不等于没中毒。

shots.section_title: 易燃气体：通风、远离火源
shots.scene: 易燃气体气瓶放在通风良好的气瓶柜里
shots.prompt_en: A flammable gas cylinder stands secured inside a ventilated gas cabinet with airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃气体如氢气，要放在通风良好处。
overlay: 易燃气体：通风、远离火源

shots.section_title: 易燃气体：通风、远离火源
shots.scene: 明火、火花、发热设备三个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: an open flame, a spark, and a hot plate glowing red. No people.
shots.narration: 远离明火、火花和发热设备。

shots.scene: 手指碰门把手冒出小火花，旁边是气体云
shots.prompt_en: A tiny static spark jumps from a fingertip to a metal handle next to a faint gas cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 一点点静电火花，也可能引燃。

shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger with a serious face.
shots.narration: 易燃气体，一个小火源就够了。

shots.scene: 腐蚀图标气瓶，旁边一只手图标泛红
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder with a corrosion pictogram next to a hand icon with a red burn mark. No people.
shots.narration: 氨、氯化氢等腐蚀性气体，会灼伤皮肤。

shots.scene: 防护服图标上出现破洞
shots.prompt_en: A protective coat icon with holes eaten into the fabric. No people.
shots.narration: 连阻燃防护服都可能被它破坏。

shots.scene: 一只气瓶图标旁加入水滴，危害图标变成腐蚀
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder icon next to a water drop; an arrow points to a corrosion pictogram appearing. No people.
shots.narration: 有的气本身不腐蚀，遇水就变了。

shots.scene: 小研用手指着空白安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a blank safety data sheet with a water drop icon on it.
shots.narration: 所以要查清说明书，管好潮湿环境。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个圆圈上有火焰的标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up an oxidizer warning sign.
shots.narration: 氧气是最常见的氧化性气体。

shots.scene: 小火苗遇到氧气箭头后变成大火
shots.prompt_en: A small flame grows into a big flame when oxygen arrows flow into it. No people.
shots.narration: 它不自己燃烧，却让燃烧更猛烈。

shots.scene: 氧气瓶和可燃气瓶、油桶之间隔开一段距离
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen cylinder kept apart from a flammable gas cylinder and an oil can, with a wide gap and a divider between them. No people.
shots.narration: 要和可燃气体、油类等可燃物分开。

shots.scene: 病房门上的禁止烟火标志和氧气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A ward door with a no open flame sign next to an oxygen cylinder icon. No people.
shots.narration: 医院用氧处，都会贴出警示。

shots.scene: 氧气箭头流向材料，冒出火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: Oxygen arrows flowing onto a pile of fabric and paper, which bursts into a flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气混入其他气体或材料，可能致命。

shots.scene: 一只没固定的大气瓶倾倒，砸向小人图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tall unsecured cylinder tipping over toward a person pictogram, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶本身也危险：没固定会倒。

shots.scene: 老李用链条把气瓶固定在墙架上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer secures an upright cylinder to a wall rack with a chain.
shots.narration: 直立放稳，可靠固定。

shots.scene: 气瓶阀门断裂，小部件沿箭头飞出
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cylinder valve snapping off and a small part flying away along a long arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶内压力高，断裂部件会飞出去。

shots.scene: 飞出的箭头击中墙上的小人图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: The flying part arrow hits a person pictogram and a wall icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 沿途的人和物，都可能被击中。

shots.scene: 老李给气瓶戴上瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer screws a protective cap onto the valve of a cylinder.
shots.narration: 不用时戴好瓶帽，保护阀门。

shots.section_title: 危害能控制，措施要落实
shots.scene: 欣欣站在整齐固定的气瓶旁竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up beside neatly chained gas cylinders.
shots.narration: 危害不可怕，防护措施做到位。
overlay: 危害能控制，措施要落实

shots.section_title: 危害能控制，措施要落实
shots.scene: 王老师给学生讲解气瓶使用规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains a blank gas cylinder procedure card to a small group of students.
shots.narration: 储存、搬运、使用，都按规程来。

shots.section_title: 惰性气体用气间：通风和氧含量报警
shots.scene: 氮气、氩气、二氧化碳三只气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Three gas cylinder icons with blank labels and a cloud icon that shows no color and no smell. No people.
shots.narration: 氮气、氩气等惰性气体，也会致人窒息。
overlay: 惰性气体用气间：通风和氧含量报警

shots.section_title: 惰性气体用气间：通风和氧含量报警
shots.scene: 无色无味图标，鼻子图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An invisible gas cloud outline next to a nose icon crossed out, showing it cannot be smelled. No people.
shots.narration: 无色无味，闻不出来。

shots.section_title: 惰性气体用气间：通风和氧含量报警
shots.scene: 墙上的氧含量报警器和通风口
shots.prompt_en: A wall-mounted oxygen monitor with a blank display and a warning lamp, next to a ventilation grille. No people.
shots.narration: 用气房间要通风，装氧含量报警器。

shots.section_title: 惰性气体用气间：通风和氧含量报警
shots.scene: 报警灯闪烁，小研快步走出房间
shots.prompt_en: The warning lamp flashes and the female graduate student walks quickly out of the room.
shots.narration: 一报警，先离开，别进去找原因。

shots.section_title: 有毒腐蚀气体泄漏：撤离报告
shots.scene: 阿杰闻到刺激性气味，捂住口鼻
shots.prompt_en: The young male student covers his nose and mouth with his sleeve, an odor wave icon nearby.
shots.narration: 闻到刺激性气味或气体报警，
overlay: 有毒腐蚀气体泄漏：撤离报告

shots.section_title: 有毒腐蚀气体泄漏：撤离报告
shots.scene: 阿杰和小研沿疏散方向撤离
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student walk out of the lab along an evacuation arrow.
shots.narration: 立即撤离，提醒周围的人。

shots.section_title: 有毒腐蚀气体泄漏：撤离报告
shots.scene: 冲进烟雾救人的小人图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person rushing into a gas cloud without protection, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要冒险返回关阀或救人。

shots.section_title: 有毒腐蚀气体泄漏：撤离报告
shots.scene: 小研打电话，旁边是三级报告图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call; beside her are icons of a lab, a department building and a security shield.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.section_title: 有毒腐蚀气体泄漏：撤离报告
shots.scene: 电话图标旁是火焰和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a flame icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 火警拨119，有人受伤拨120。

shots.section_title: 富氧环境：衣物沾氧易燃
shots.scene: 氧气瓶阀门旁冒出氧气箭头，飘到实验服上
shots.prompt_en: Oxygen arrows drift from a cylinder valve onto a hanging lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气泄漏后，衣服头发会吸附氧气。
overlay: 富氧环境：衣物沾氧易燃

shots.section_title: 富氧环境：衣物沾氧易燃
shots.scene: 沾氧的衣服靠近火源被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lab coat covered in oxygen arrows near a flame, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 这时遇到火源，极易燃烧。

shots.section_title: 富氧环境：衣物沾氧易燃
shots.scene: 小研站在通风处拍打衣服，远离火源
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands by an open window, airing out her lab coat, far from any flame.
shots.narration: 先通风散气，远离一切火源。

shots.scene: 实验室里只放着一只正在使用的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A lab corner with just one secured gas cylinder in use and plenty of empty space. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里的气瓶，按需领用。

shots.scene: 实验室里堆满气瓶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lab crowded with many gas cylinders, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不囤气瓶，用完及时退回。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白台账上核对气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks cylinders against a blank inventory ledger.
shots.narration: 建好台账，具体按本校规定执行。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现四个危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four floating diamond hazard pictograms.
shots.narration: 识别四类危害，分清主次。

shots.scene: 窒息、中毒、灼伤三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a low oxygen warning, a skull and crossbones, and a burned hand. No people.
shots.narration: 窒息、中毒、灼伤，都要提防。

shots.scene: 易燃气瓶远离火源，氧气瓶远离油类
shots.prompt_en: A flammable gas cylinder far from a flame and an oxygen cylinder far from an oil can. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃远离火源，氧气远离可燃物。

shots.scene: 链条固定的气瓶，戴着瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: A chained upright cylinder with its protective cap on. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶固定好，瓶帽戴好。

shots.scene: 撤离箭头和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: An evacuation arrow and a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一有泄漏，先撤离再报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的气瓶架旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy, chained gas cylinder rack.
shots.narration: 认清危害，安全用气，下次见！
